item.name: Family
item.description: The family app: what a family member and the next of kin do.

item.name: Family Membership
item.description: Joining a family, the family code, members and handover.

item.name: Family Invitations
item.description: Invitations to join a family, and the ones the next of kin sent.

request.description: A signed-in user accepts an invitation addressed to their email. No password; used to link an existing account to another resident.

Invite Family: the next of kin invites a relative. Body: residentId, name, email, relationship (a value from relationship options). The invitee gets an email with a one-time link valid for 7 days. With EMAIL_ENABLED on the sender never receives the link. While it is off, nothing is delivered, so the response also includes acceptUrl and this request saves its token in familyInviteToken for accept family invitation. Next of kin only (403 otherwise); 400 for a missing name or bad relationship or email; 409 if the email belongs to a staff member, is already a member, or already has a pending invitation. Figma screen: Invite Family (Send Invite).
Invitations this next of kin sent for the resident, newest first, with status (pending, accepted, revoked, expired). Optional query: status, page, limit. Next of kin only.

item.name: Family Members
item.description: Residents, members, family code, join requests and handover.

request.description: Options for the Relationship dropdowns (Grandson, Daughter, Niece...). Needs a family token but no active link, so the Join A Family screen can use it. Figma screens: Join A Family, Invite Family.

Residents the member is actively linked to, with the active one flagged (Who are you viewing?). residentId is optional: the resident the app is showing; without it the first one is flagged. Residents of a home with Family Engagement off are left out. Returns an empty list when the member has no active link yet. Built as one aggregation (links joined to organization, resident and home). Figma screen: Home Family Tab (Who are you viewing? and the header dropdown).

My Family: the people linked to the resident, with name, photo, relationship, Next Of Kin badge, status and isYou. The next of kin also sees people who asked to join (status pending, canReview true); everyone else sees active members only. canRemove and canReview say which buttons to show. Figma screen: My Family.

Removes an active member; their access ends on their next request. Only the resident's next of kin. 409 for the next of kin (hand over first) or for someone who hasn't been approved (reject the request instead); 404 for anyone else's member. Figma screen: My Family (Remove).

Leave this family. Body: residentId. The next of kin gets 409 next_of_kin_must_hand_over until someone has taken over. Leaving also withdraws any handover that was asked of this member. Figma screen: Profile & Settings (Leave This Family).

The resident's current family code and when it expires. code is null when there is none or it has expired, so the app shows Make A New Code. Next of kin only: 403 for another family member, 404 when the resident isn't one of yours, 400 when residentId is missing. Figma screen: Invite Family (family code card).
Make A New Code: creates a code valid for 14 days and voids the old one. The code never contains the resident's room number. Next of kin only. Figma screen: Invite Family (Make A New Code).

The Code Accepted card: checks a typed code and returns the home name only (the resident stays hidden until approval). Wrong 404, expired or replaced 410, and 429 after 5 wrong tries in 15 minutes (the message says how many minutes are left). Figma screen: Join A Family (code entry, Wrong, Expired, Locked).

Send Join Request: body code and relationship (one of the values from relationship options). Creates a pending request for the next of kin or the home to approve. Errors: 400 invalid_relationship, 404/410/429 for the code, 409 join_request_pending (one at a time), 409 family_link_exists, 409 email_used_by_staff. Figma screen: Join A Family.
The member's pending request (home name, Waiting), or null when there is none. Figma screen: Join A Family (Request Sent, Waiting).

PUT with body {"action":"cancel"}. Cancel Request, after the confirmation dialog. Only the member who asked, and only while it is pending (409 otherwise, 404 for anyone else's request). Figma screen: Join A Family (Cancel Request).
Requests waiting for review, oldest first, paginated. Next of kin only (403 for another member, 404 when the resident isn't yours, 400 without residentId). Figma screen: My Family (Review).

PUT with body {"action":"approve"}. Approves a pending request: the person becomes an active member and sees the resident from their next call. Only the resident's next of kin; 404 for anyone else (so other families' requests stay hidden), 409 if the request was already decided. Figma screen: My Family (Review).

PUT with body {"action":"reject"}. Rejects a pending request. The person can send a new request later. Only the resident's next of kin; 404 for anyone else, 409 if already decided. Figma screen: My Family (Review).

Who the next of kin can hand over to: active members (canSelect true) and people still waiting for approval (shown, canSelect false), plus the option to let the home choose. Next of kin only. Figma screen: Leave Margaret's Family (Handover To).

Asks one member to take over as next of kin. Body: residentId and toMemberId (a memberId from handover candidates). The next of kin keeps the role until the person accepts. Errors: 400 handover_target_required / handover_to_self, 404 family_member_not_found, 409 handover_member_not_approved or handover_pending (one open handover per resident). Figma screen: Leave Margaret's Family (Ask James To Take Over).

Lets the home choose the new next of kin. Body: residentId and homeChooses true. The next of kin keeps the role until the home assigns someone. Figma screen: Leave Margaret's Family (Let Florence House Choose).

The open handover the caller is part of, or null. direction is outgoing for the next of kin who asked and incoming for the person asked; to is null when the home chooses. residentId is optional. Figma screen: Leave Margaret's Family (James Must Accept).

PUT with body {"action":"accept"}. The person asked accepts and becomes next of kin; the previous next of kin stays a regular member. Done together or not at all. 404 for anyone but the person asked, 409 if no longer open or no longer valid (the next of kin changed or someone left).
PUT with body {"action":"decline"}. The person asked declines; the next of kin keeps the role. 404 for anyone but the person asked, 409 if no longer open.

PUT with body {"action":"cancel"}. Keep My Role: the next of kin withdraws the request. 404 for anyone but the next of kin who asked, 409 if no longer open. Figma screen: Leave Margaret's Family (Keep My Role).

item.name: Moderation
item.description: A family member's own uploads, from photo to approval.

request.description: New Upload: Upload Photos. Body is form-data with one image in the field file (choose a file in Postman). Images only, up to 10 MB; the server checks it is a real image, resizes it to 2048px and stores it. Sets mediaId for send upload for approval. One photo per call.

New Upload: Upload Photos, several at once. Form-data field files; select up to 10 images in that one row (10 MB each, 50 MB together). Every file is checked before any is stored, so one bad file stores nothing and the error names it. Returns photos, a list of mediaId in the order sent. Sets mediaId (the first) and mediaIds (all, as a JSON list): in send upload for approval replace ["{{mediaId}}"] with {{mediaIds}} to attach them all.

New Upload: Send For Approval. Body: residentId, message (up to 500 characters), mediaIds (up to 10, from upload photo), includeInGazette, clientId. Needs a message or a photo. 400 photos_cannot_be_shared when the resident has photo sharing off (a message alone is allowed); 400 for too many photos, a message over 500 characters or photos that are not yours; 404 for a resident you are not linked to. The same clientId returns the upload already made. Saved as waiting; nobody but you sees it until a manager approves.

query.description: Tab: waiting, approved or rejected
One resident

request.description: My Uploads: Approved, Waiting For Approval and Not Approved (with rejectionReason). Optional query: status (waiting, approved, rejected), residentId, page, limit. meta.counts has the three totals and ignores the status filter. Photos show the blurred copy once one exists. Rejected uploads disappear 30 days after rejection.

My Uploads: Edit And Resend. Body (all optional): message, mediaIds, includeInGazette. A waiting or not approved upload returns to waiting with the reason cleared. 409 upload_not_editable once approved; 404 for someone else's upload or after you were removed from the family.

item.name: Gazette
item.description: The gazette being collected, the printed ones and the reader.

request.description: The Gazette tab's top card: the gazette being collected now. Query: residentId (required). scheduled is false until the organization has saved a gazette schedule (then issue is null and there is nothing to show). Otherwise issue has number (No. 15), state (collecting, or notStarted before the first issue begins), periodStart, periodEnd, periodLabel (15 Oct – 28 Oct 2026) and closesAt (the Closes 28 Oct pill). messageCap is 30, messagesUsed is the 9 in '9 of 30 messages' (approved messages meant for the gazette; at most the cap), messagesSent is how many were sent in all, remaining, overflow (sent beyond the cap, which wait for the next gazette), isFull (the Gazette full screen) and percentFull for the progress bar. A message printed in an earlier gazette, or taken out by staff, does not count again.

Printed gazettes: the gazettes the home has printed for the resident, newest first. Query: residentId (required), page, limit. Each row has gazetteId, title (The Hughes Family Gazette), issueNumber (Gazette no. 14), periodLabel (1 Oct – 14 Oct 2026), messageCount, pageCount (the 6 pages), printedAt and givenAt (the 'Printed 15 Oct · given 15 Oct' line, with givenAt empty until the home records it) and latest, true on the newest one overall (the Latest pill and the card on the Gazette tab). Only printed gazettes are listed.

Read gazette: the printed gazette for the reader. gazetteId comes from printed gazettes. title, issueNumber, periodLabel (No. 14 · 1–14 Oct 2026), residentName (for Margaret), homeName, pageCount, printedAt and givenAt. cover is the best photo of the issue (the newest photo) with its message, headline, authorName and relationshipLabel, or null when there is no photo. messages are the family's messages oldest first: authorName, relationshipLabel (Daughter), message, photos and sentAt. life is Life at the home: title, text, photoUrl and postedAt. Photos are the blurred copy wherever one exists. Anything no longer allowed is left out on every read: a resident whose photo sharing is off has no photos, and a wall post that was removed is gone. 404 gazette_not_found for a gazette that is not printed, belongs to another resident, or is not yours.

The PDF of a printed gazette, the copy the home printed (drawn again from the saved content if the file was lost). download=false opens it inline; otherwise it is an attachment. Same visibility rules as read gazette. Rate limited. In Postman use Send and Download to save it.

item.name: Timeline
item.description: Everything shared about the resident.

request.description: Home Family Tab, Family: everything shared about the resident, newest first. Query: residentId (required), page, limit (default 20, max 50). Approved uploads from any family member only; waiting and rejected ones never appear. Each item has type, authorName, authorPhotoUrl, authorRelationship, message, photos (the blurred copy where one exists) and publishedAt (when it was approved). 404 if you are not linked to the resident or the module is off.

item.name: Newsletters
item.description: Current and past newsletters of the home: list, read and PDF.

request.description: Newsletters (menu): current and past issues of the resident's home, newest sent first. Query: residentId (required, it picks the home), page, limit. Only newsletters that were sent into the app are listed; drafts, scheduled ones and ones sent only by email are not. Each row has newsletterId, title, homeName, month, periodLabel (October 2026), issueNumber, sentAt, editedAt and a short summary from the welcome note.

Newsletter screen: the whole issue for reading: title, homeName, periodLabel, issueNumber, sentAt, editedAt (the 'edited 1 Oct' line), the welcome note with signature, highlights (title, text, photoUrl, postedAt), coming up (date, time, title, description, category), notices, new residents, gallery and the footer. Only the sections the home switched on are returned. Posts removed, and residents whose photo sharing is now off, are left out on every read (BR-06). 404 newsletter_not_found for a draft, a scheduled one, one not sent into the app, or another home's. Send the family token; any of your linked homes works.

The PDF button on the Newsletter screen: the same A4 PDF the home emails (the copy stored when it was sent, or drawn from what was sent when none was stored). download=false opens it inline; otherwise it is an attachment. Same visibility rules as read newsletter. Rate limited. In Postman use Send and Download to save it.

item.name: Community Wall
item.description: The home's wall: read it and react.

request.description: Home Family Tab, Community Wall: the home's published posts, pinned first then newest. Query: residentId (required, it picks the home), page, limit. Each post has homeName, authorName, message, photos, isPinned, reactionCount, reactedByMe and taggedResidents (only residents you are linked to). Sets postId from the first post for the reaction requests.

request.description: Moderation queue: uploads families sent. Every status by default, newest first, so decided uploads stay visible; status=waiting lists only the queue, oldest first. Needs the Family Engagement module (404 when it is off) and the matching permission: familyEngagement.view to read, .manage to change, .approve to decide join requests. Owners and super admins always have them; a site or line manager needs them granted.

Rejects a waiting upload. Body: action reject and reason (required, up to 500 characters). The author sees the reason under Not Approved and is notified; the upload is removed 30 days later. Needs the Family Engagement module (404 when it is off) and the matching permission: familyEngagement.view to read, .manage to change, .approve to decide join requests. request.description: Staff Community Wall: every post of the organization, pinned first then newest. Optional query: status (published, draft, scheduled or removed), branchId, residentId (the Resident filter: tagged), authorId (the Author filter), audience (the Group filter: all, branch or tagged), days (Last 30 days: 1 to 365; it cannot be combined with from and to; it also sets the window of meta.activity), pinned=true, hasPhotos=true, from and to (2026-10-01), sort (newest or oldest), keyword (post text, tagged resident or author), page, limit. Each post has the author (name, photo, role), the home, photos, tagged residents with their photos, isPinned and reactionCount. meta.counts has published, draft, scheduled, removed, pinned and photos for the tabs (scheduled posts are listed soonest first, drafts by last edit). Each post has audience (all, branch or tagged) and audienceLabel (All families & residents, Florence House families or Tagged resident families), and audienceCount is how many families it is for (the 42 in Seen 31/42). The same response carries the rest of the screen: meta.gazette is the 'Gazette no. 14 closes in 3 days' card (pass branchId for one site; without it the card covers every site that is not suspended: the resident counts are added up, the earliest close is shown, number is the highest next number and sites says how many sites it covers): scheduled (false until a gazette schedule is saved), number, state, periodLabel, closesAt, closesInDays, messageCap, residents {total, withContent, noContent, noFamily, overCap} ('33 of 42 residents have content', '4 no content', '1 over 30') and percentWithContent for the progress bar; it is null only when the organization has no site that is not suspended, or the branchId is not one of its sites. Also meta.attention (the Needs your attention card: pendingUploads {count, oldestAt}, reportedPosts {count, reports, oldestAt}, total) and meta.activity (Staff activity: days and authors with posts, name, photo and role; query days 1 to 365, default 30). Each post also has seenCount, audienceCount, recentReactors (latest 3), reportCount and reports (its open reports, newest 5: reporterName, reason, createdAt); they ignore the status, pinned and photos filters but follow the others. Needs familyEngagement.view; 404 when the module is off.

Community Wall: the reports on a post are judged unfounded; the post stays and its open reports close. Removing the post instead closes them as actioned. A site or line manager can only act on their own site. Needs familyEngagement.manage. Needs the Family Engagement module (404 when it is off) and the matching permission: familyEngagement.view to read, .manage to change, .approve to decide join requests. Owners and super admins always have them; a site or line manager needs them granted.

The tag picker: residents of the site that photo sharing is on for. A site or line manager always gets their own site; an owner or super admin can pass branchId (or none for every site). Needs the Family Engagement module (404 when it is off) and the matching permission: familyEngagement.view to read, .manage to change, .approve to decide join requests. Owners and super admins always have them; a site or line manager needs them granted.
One photo for a wall post. Form-data field file (choose a file in Postman). Images only, up to 10 MB; resized and stored. Sets mediaId for create post. Needs familyEngagement.manage.

Several photos for a wall post. Form-data field files; select up to 10 images in that one row. Returns photos with their mediaIds. Sets mediaId (the first) and mediaIds (all, as a JSON list): in create post replace ["{{mediaId}}"] with {{mediaIds}}. Needs familyEngagement.manage.

Staff Community Wall: new post. Body: title (optional, up to 120 characters), branchId (a site or line manager posts to their own site and leaves it out. An owner or super admin can leave it out when the post is for tagged residents' families (the site is the one the tagged residents are at; tagged residents at two sites return 400 tagged_residents_different_sites) or when the organization has only one active site; otherwise they must send it, or get 400 branch_required), message (up to 2000 characters), mediaIds (up to 10, from upload post photo), taggedResidentIds (up to 50, only residents of that site with photo sharing on, from taggable residents) and isPinned. Needs text or a photo. audience is Who can see this post?: all (All Families & Residents, the default: every family in the organization, at every site), branch (the site's families, such as Florence House Families) or tagged (Tagged Resident Families Only: only the families of the residents tagged, so at least one resident must be tagged, 400 audience_needs_tags). 400 invalid_post_audience for any other value. Goes live straight away with no approval and the people the audience reaches get a notification: everyone in the organization, the site's families, or the families of the tagged residents. Optional status: published (default), draft (saved, nobody sees it) or scheduled; scheduledAt (an ISO date in the future, up to a year ahead, such as 2026-11-02T09:00:00Z) alone also means scheduled. Families are notified when a scheduled post goes live, which a job checks every minute. 400 post_schedule_invalid for a bad date. 400 residents_cannot_be_tagged for a resident with photo sharing off or at another site. Needs familyEngagement.manage. Needs the Family Engagement module (404 when it is off) and the matching permission: familyEngagement.view to read, .manage to change, .approve to decide join requests. Owners and super admins always have them; a site or line manager needs them granted.

Edit the text, photos or tags, change who can see it (audience), or pin and unpin. Anything not sent stays as it was; changing the audience does not notify anyone again. Same checks as create. A site or line manager can only change their own site's posts. Families are not notified again for a published post. A draft or scheduled post can also get status (draft, scheduled or published) and scheduledAt: published makes it live now, notifies families and sets its posted time to now. 409 post_already_published when a published post is sent back to draft or scheduled. Needs the Family Engagement module (404 when it is off) and the matching permission: familyEngagement.view to read, .manage to change, .approve to decide join requests. Owners and super admins always have them; a site or line manager needs them granted.

Removes the post from every feed and from future newsletters and gazettes. The row is kept. Sending it again returns 404. Needs the Family Engagement module (404 when it is off) and the matching permission: familyEngagement.view to read, .manage to change, .approve to decide join requests. query.description: Tab: draft, scheduled, sending or sent

request.description: Newsletters page: every newsletter of the organization, newest month first. Optional query: status, branchId, month (2026-10), keyword (title), page, limit. meta.counts has draft, scheduled, sending and sent and ignores the status filter. Needs familyEngagement.view; 404 when the module is off.

Content Sections and Preview: title, month, issue number, status, the six sections with their switches, welcome, highlights with photos, coming up, notices, new residents, gallery, footer, and recipients (families and people who would receive it). Needs familyEngagement.view.

The Preview and the Download PDF button. Returns the newsletter as an A4 PDF drawn like the home's template: header, welcome, the month's posts with photos, coming up and notices side by side, new residents, photo gallery and footer. Only the sections that are switched on are drawn. A draft is drawn fresh, leaving out posts removed and residents whose photo sharing is off since it was built; a sent newsletter serves the copy stored when it was sent (when the PDF channel was on). Query download=true sends it as an attachment, otherwise it opens inline. In Postman use Send and Download to save it. Needs familyEngagement.view.

Newsletters: pick the month (the Newsletter month dropdown). Body: branchId (an owner or super admin must pick the site; a site or line manager uses their own), month (2026-10), and optionally title and template (classic, the only one for now). One newsletter per site and month (409 newsletter_exists_for_month); remove the draft to start again. The draft is filled in: highlights from the month's live wall posts, gallery from their photos, new residents admitted that month with photo sharing on, the footer from the site, the standard Share your photos notice, and who signs it (your name and role, such as Claire Adams, Site Manager). The response is the whole builder: the sections with their switches, the preview content (the home, organizationName, periodLabel and issueNumber for the Issue 14 line), counts for each section, and recipients {families, members} for the 42 families badge. Needs familyEngagement.manage. Needs the Family Engagement module (404 when it is off) and the matching permission: familyEngagement.view to read, .manage to change, .approve to decide join requests. Owners and super admins always have them; a site or line manager needs them granted.

Save draft (and every edit on the builder). Only a draft. Body, all optional: title, template, sections (welcome, highlights, comingUp, notices, newResidents, gallery as true or false), welcome {text, signedBy}, highlights [{postId, title, text, mediaId}], comingUp [{date, time (14:30), title, description, category}] (kept in date order), notices [{title, body}], newResidentIds [residentId], gallery [{mediaId, caption}], footer {homeName, address, phone, email}, delivery {inApp, email, pdf} (the choices under Send & Delivery), refill (a list of sections to pull from the wall again: highlights, gallery, newResidents; use it after new wall posts were added, it replaces only the named sections and a list sent in the same request wins). A list sent replaces the whole list; anything not sent is left alone. Highlights must be live posts of the site, gallery photos must come from them, and new residents must be admitted residents of the site with photo sharing on. 409 once scheduled or sent. Needs familyEngagement.manage. Needs the Family Engagement module (404 when it is off) and the matching permission: familyEngagement.view to read, .manage to change, .approve to decide join requests. Owners and super admins always have them; a site or line manager needs them granted.

Send & Delivery: the Send newsletter button (When: Send now). Body: action send, and optionally delivery {inApp, email, pdf} to set the checkboxes now; without it the choices saved on the draft are used and at least one must be on (400 newsletter_delivery_required). A newsletter needs at least one switched-on section with something in it (400 newsletter_empty). Channels: inApp notifies every active family member at the site once each; pdf draws the PDF and stores it (pdfKey); email sends each distinct family address its own message (nobody sees another address) with the PDF attached. The email is sent only when EMAIL_ENABLED is true on the server; otherwise the channel is recorded as skipped. deliveryLog says what happened per channel: done with count (and failed), failed, or skipped. A failing address does not stop the others. Sending is done before the response returns, so a very large home takes longer. Posts removed, or residents whose photo sharing was switched off, since the draft are left out. The response is the sent newsletter with status sent, sentAt, sentBy, sentTo {families, members} and deliveryLog. One send wins if it is clicked twice (409 newsletter_already_sent for the other). Progress is written after each channel, and a send that stops part-way (the server died) is finished by the scheduler job after 15 minutes without progress: finished channels are skipped and nobody is notified or emailed twice. Needs familyEngagement.manage. Needs the Family Engagement module (404 when it is off) and the matching permission: familyEngagement.view to read, .manage to change, .approve to decide join requests. Owners and super admins always have them; a site or line manager needs them granted.

Send & Delivery: Schedule for later. Body: action schedule, sendAt (an ISO date in the future, up to a year ahead) and optionally delivery. Calling it again on a scheduled newsletter moves it to a new time. While scheduled it cannot be edited or deleted; cancel the schedule first. A job checks every minute and sends what is due, on behalf of the person who scheduled it. 400 newsletter_send_at_invalid for a bad time. Needs the Family Engagement module (404 when it is off) and the matching permission: familyEngagement.view to read, .manage to change, .approve to decide join requests. Owners and super admins always have them; a site or line manager needs them granted.

Takes a scheduled newsletter back to a draft so it can be edited again. 409 newsletter_not_scheduled for anything else. Needs the Family Engagement module (404 when it is off) and the matching permission: familyEngagement.view to read, .manage to change, .approve to decide join requests. Owners and super admins always have them; a site or line manager needs them granted.

Removes a draft and frees its month. 409 for a scheduled or sent newsletter. Needs the Family Engagement module (404 when it is off) and the matching permission: familyEngagement.view to read, .manage to change, .approve to decide join requests. Owners and super admins always have them; a site or line manager needs them granted.

request.description: The Gazettes page: one row per resident for the issue each site is on now. Optional query: branchId (one site), status (the tab: all, ready, noContent, overCap, printed, noFamily, failed or building), keyword (resident, room or status), page, limit. Each row has itemId, residentName, photoUrl, roomNumber, familyCount (Family column), messageCount (Messages column; it can be over the cap, like 31), state and statusLabel (Ready, No content, Over 30 messages, Printed, No family linked, Failed or Building), hasPdf, generatedAt, printedAt and givenAt. meta.counts feeds the cards and tabs: total (Residents in this issue), ready (Ready to print), noContent, overCap, printed, noFamily, failed, building and needReview (the Need review card: no content, failed or over the cap); it ignores the tab chosen. The page shows nothing about the issue itself, so none is returned; the Over 30 messages label already carries the cap. Needs familyEngagement.view.

One resident's gazette to check and fix: the issue, the resident, state and statusLabel, familyCount, messageCount, includedCount, overCap, hasPdf and the print dates. messages lists every message sent for it with uploadId, authorName, relationshipLabel, message, photos (the blurred copy, which is what is printed), sentAt and placement: included, movedToNext (over the cap, waiting for the next issue) or removed (taken out by staff). life lists the wall posts for Life at the home. Needs familyEngagement.view.

The eye icon (preview) and the download: the resident's gazette as an A4 PDF, the stored copy when there is one, otherwise drawn from the saved content. download=true sends it as an attachment, otherwise it opens inline. 409 gazette_nothing_to_show for a resident with no messages or no family. In Postman use Send and Download to save it. Needs familyEngagement.view.

The Download all PDFs button: a zip of every drawn gazette (ready or printed) of the issue each site is on, one PDF per resident named like margaret-hughes-gazette-issue-14.pdf; with several sites each has a folder. Optional query: branchId. 404 gazette_nothing_to_download when nothing has been drawn yet, 400 for more than 100 gazettes (choose a site). Rate limited. Needs familyEngagement.view.

The Generate all button. Works out what every resident's gazette will say for the site's current issue and answers at once (202); the PDFs are drawn in the background, so the rows show Building and then Ready as each one finishes. If the server stops while drawing, a scheduled job (every 5 minutes) draws any gazette that has stayed at Building for 20 minutes, once, so nothing stays stuck. Once an organization has saved its gazette schedule, a job also builds each site's issue by itself when its period closes (checked every 15 minutes; a site with no admitted residents is skipped and an issue that exists is never built twice), and reminds the people linked at the site three days before an issue closes. Body: branchId (an owner or super admin must pick the site; a site or line manager uses their own). With no gazette schedule saved the issue covers the last cycle's days; with one it is the issue that is open now. Asking again builds the same issue again: new messages come in, and gazettes already printed are left exactly as they are. The response has the issue (issueId, number, period, closesAt) and counts of what was built. Needs familyEngagement.manage. Needs the Family Engagement module (404 when it is off) and the matching permission: familyEngagement.view to read, .manage to change, .approve to decide join requests. Owners and super admins always have them; a site or line manager needs them granted.

The refresh icon: picks up messages that arrived since and draws the PDF again, then returns the gazette like gazette detail. Optional body: removeUploadIds (messages in this gazette to take out for good; they never come back in a later issue) and uploadIds (exactly which messages go in, from the ones sent for this gazette, at least one and at most the cap; the rest wait for the next issue, which is how staff choose the final 30 when more were sent). 400 gazette_upload_invalid or gazette_selection_invalid for a bad choice. 409 gazette_already_printed once printed. Needs familyEngagement.manage; a site or line manager only on their own site. Needs the Family Engagement module (404 when it is off) and the matching permission: familyEngagement.view to read, .manage to change, .approve to decide join requests.
